name: dovey
description: Make and run Meta ads with Dovey: research the winning ads in a category and from competitors, write a brief, and make new ads in your brand's colours, type and voice, each an editable design on Dovey's canvas.

interface.longDescription: Dovey reads your brand from its website, finds the winning ads in your category and from your competitors, writes a brief, and makes new Facebook and Instagram ads in your brand's colours, type and voice. Every ad is an editable design on a Dovey canvas. Needs a Dovey account: signing in for the first time makes one on the Free plan, with limited usage each week and no card. Research and new ads use the plan's weekly usage.
defaultPrompt: Use Dovey to set up my brand and make my first 3 ads.
Research the winning ads in my category and from my competitors.
Write a brief for 5 new ads from that research, then make them.
